memory_update.text: PLPC should remain a high-priority underfollowed grid-hardware candidate because its products sit directly in transmission/distribution line construction and the FulcrumAir robotic installation partnership may create a hidden labor-productivity and approved-hardware signal.
HPS.A remains a high-priority transformer/power-quality candidate, but the thesis must be upgraded only after primary filings verify backlog, lead times and data-center-specific revenue exposure.
AZZ is a second-order grid-steel coatings candidate; the relationship is plausible but must be tested by utility/transmission end-market revenue share and regional galvanizing utilization.
VMI and MYRG are useful demand-context anchors for grid capex: VMI for utility structures and MYRG for T&D construction backlog, but neither is as clean a component bottleneck as PLPC or HPS.A.
HUBB should be retained as a reference leader for transmission/substation demand, DMC Power connector economics and pricing comparisons rather than as the primary underfollowed target.
LEU and BWXT map to nuclear fuel-cycle chokepoints, but the investable relationships are highly dependent on DOE/NRC timelines, contract economics, capacity milestones and current market crowding.

Quality Power Electrical Equipments/QPOWER needs primary-source validation from NSE/BSE filings, RHP/DRHP, annual report, exchange announcements, cash-flow conversion and governance checks before it can move from speculative_shadow to underfollowed.

For every ticker in this chunk, Layer 2C should add current market cap, liquidity, analyst coverage, short interest, valuation context and social/media attention checks to prevent crowded names from being mislabeled underfollowed.

summary: Layer 2B maps the candidate chunk into ticker-node relationships for the Energy theme, emphasizing power availability, transmission/grid hardening, data-center electrical infrastructure, and nuclear fuel-cycle bottlenecks. The strongest underfollowed relationships in this chunk are PLPC as utility-approved transmission-line hardware, HPS.A as dry-type transformer and power-quality exposure, AZZ as second-order galvanizing/corrosion protection for grid steel, VMI as utility structures, and MYRG as a smaller T&D construction demand-channel validator. LEU and BWXT provide nuclear fuel-cycle exposure, but their relationships are more policy/licensing dependent and less cleanly underfollowed. HUBB is retained as a reference leader for pricing, acquisition and demand-context checks rather than as the main alpha candidate. Quality Power Electrical Equipments is mapped as a speculative international HVDC/high-voltage component candidate because external evidence suggests relevant exposure, but investability, ticker conventions, liquidity, governance, order quality and primary filings still need verification.

ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Pull latest PLPC 10-K/10-Q and investor deck; quantify energy-product revenue mix, transmission-market growth commentary, backlog/order language, customer concentration, gross margin trend, and any disclosed FulcrumAir commercialization milestones.
ticker_relationships.relationship: Preformed Line Products maps directly to engineered products used in construction and maintenance of energy, telecom and critical infrastructure networks, including transmission and distribution line support/protection/connectivity products. Its FulcrumAir robotic installation partnership adds a labor-productivity and utility-workflow angle that may increase stickiness if utilities standardize on PLP-compatible installation methods.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Backlog growth, lead times, percentage of revenue from digital infrastructure/data centers, margin uplift from power-quality products, customer concentration, and capacity-addition execution.

ticker_relationships.relationship: Hammond Power Solutions maps to dry-type transformers, custom transformer capacity, power-quality and electrical-infrastructure demand. The strongest theme linkage is data-center, industrial electrification, microgrid and replacement demand where transformers can be schedule-critical.

ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Download NSE/BSE filings, RHP/DRHP, FY2025/FY2026 annual report, investor presentation and exchange announcements; reconcile reported order book with cash conversion and segment revenue.
ticker_relationships.relationship: Quality Power Electrical Equipments maps to high-voltage electrical solutions, including HVDC and FACTS equipment, renewable grid connectivity and long-distance power transfer. ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Share of Metal Coatings revenue from electrical utility, transmission, distribution and solar steel; regional galvanizing utilization; lead times; pricing power; and whether utility steel demand is material enough to move consolidated earnings.

The relevant chokepoint is not electrical equipment itself but regional coating capacity for transmission, distribution, solar, substations, poles and lattice towers before field installation.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Utility segment backlog, North America utility growth, lead times, capacity additions, customer approval lists, and whether utility strength is offset by agriculture or other infrastructure cycles.
